title: A noul question cannot be sent through the shipped caller path
description: A noul question cannot be sent through the shipped caller path. `validate_question_set` rejects any question with empty choices ('question q choices are empty'), and noul requires empty choices. `--request-json` calls it at caller.rs:43. Question-set files (check.toml) refuse every type other than choice at questions.rs:45. Library users of `Question::try_new` and the facade payload can reach noul, but `sc-ai jev --request-json` can reach choice and score only. Your note says all Jev question formats must be supported.
